reading_note: The teaching describes three discrete states of the Lord's redemptive work and two states of separation from divine light. Day 1: divine truth descends into the natural mind possessed by self-love, is mingled there, and is raised by the operative power of the Spirit — the state of the church-in-conflict. Day 2: the celestial recipients reign in a renewed interior, an intermediate glorified state preceding the full unveiling. Day 3: the Father's full image is revealed; all genuine reception is gathered into the storehouses of celestial good and rests in eternal beatitude. Two Deaths: (a) the temporal death — light captive in falsity until purified by the great fire of judgment; (b) the eternal death — sinners permanently severed from the inflowing light because they profaned what is holy. The arc moves from descent → intermediate restoration → final glorification, paralleled by temporary captivity → permanent separation.
